limitations: No Java or JMeter invocation is permitted for this case. The plan is isolated under syntax-static/ because LoopController.loops=-2 is deliberately not an executable bounded oracle input; the -1 forever-loop child is retained for static wire comparison and is never entered.

Upstream semantics are recorded separately from Rust policy: RunTime.seconds=-1 means an already-expired deadline (zero child visits), a missing IfController.condition is an empty/false condition (zero child visits), and RandomController is a built-in upstream controller that selects one child per iteration without a fixed seed.
A Rust implementation may reject negative loop counts or unsupported RandomController execution with stable policy diagnostics; those policy choices must not be labeled as Apache JMeter semantics.
